page.title: What customers say about {name}

page.showMore: {count, plural, one {Show one more theme} other {Show # more themes}}

emptyNoFeedback.heading: Here you'll read what your customers say, grouped by theme.
emptyNoFeedback.lede: To get started you need feedback. Start with what you already have: tickets, call notes, survey answers. The more channels you bring together, the more complete the themes.
emptyNoFeedback.askText: A public form with one question, your choice. Answered from the phone, no account needed.
emptyNoFeedback.csvText: You need a text column. Channel, customer and date are optional. Up to 2,000 rows.
emptyNoFeedback.pasteText: The notes of an interview, or a message copied from an email or Slack.

emptyNoAnalysis.title: {count} feedback, no themes yet
emptyNoAnalysis.lede: One by one, they say little. The analysis groups them into problems, opportunities and praise, with the quotes that represent them best.
emptyNoAnalysis.quotaFirst: You'll use 1 of the {limit} analyses for {month}.
emptyNoAnalysis.quotaRemaining: {remaining, plural, one {You have 1 analysis left for {month}.} other {You have {remaining} analyses left for {month}.}}

detail.otherFeedback: The other {count} feedback in this theme

analyzeButton.runningNote: It can take a few minutes. The themes appear here as soon as it's done.

failures.no_feedback: There's no feedback to analyze from the last 90 days.
failures.busy: An analysis is already running. Reload the page in a minute.
failures.limit: You've used all your analyses for this month, or too many attempts have failed.
failures.no_themes: The analysis found no theme with at least 2 feedback and doesn't count against this month's limit. Nothing changed.
failures.failed: The analysis failed and doesn't count against this month's limit. Nothing changed: try again shortly.

limitWarning.title: You've reached {limit} feedback, the Free plan limit
limitWarning.text: The limit covers all your Research: the public forms no longer accept new feedback. With Pro, feedback is unlimited and analyses go up to 100 a month.
